Adaptive Guidance

    Intervention Effectiveness

    You and ThinkFirst evaluate whether ThinkFirst is helping. These are product-timing signals, not judgments about you.

    Research Grounding

    ThinkFirst interprets metrics as observable habits, not as grades. The research picture is mixed: structured AI use can support learning, while passive or unstructured reliance can increase cognitive offloading.

    Sources Used

      These sources justify the design logic. They do not let ThinkFirst diagnose learning, intelligence, or critical-thinking ability from browser metadata.

      How Metrics Are Measured

      Each percentage is an event ratio from local browser metadata. ThinkFirst stores whether a learning action happened, never the prompt, AI answer, source URL, clipboard text, attempt text, or reflection text.

      How Prompt Timing Works

      ThinkFirst uses decision points and burden rules. It prompts when a learning move is useful and tries to back off when timing is poor.

      Your conversation is not our data.

      GEVR Framework
      
          
      ThinkFirst is built around Generate, Evaluate, Verify, Reflect, surrounded by human agency.
      
          
      
            GenerateEvaluateVerifyReflect
          
      
          
      AI supports the cycle rather than replacing it.
      
        
      
        
      
          
      Quick
      I need an answer efficiently. Minimal friction and no session metrics.
      
          
      Learn
      Attempt First, comparison, retrieval, and balanced verification.
      
          
      Research
      Verification-heavy Claim -> Source -> Support -> Lateral check -> Judgment.
      
          
      Create
      Preserves authorship, intent, evaluation, and reflection during writing or brainstorming.
      
          
      School
      Assignment/exam process checks: allowed use, first attempt, source inspection, and what remains your own.
